subject: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks
summary: Mid-quarter leadership check-in: brief status on platform OKRs, proposal to narrow scope for QBR, and requests for two critical dependency slots. Includes customer procurement sync for a pilot that affects capacity planning.
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse ahead of next week's QBR dry run. High-level updates and three things I need from the group by EOD Monday so we can lock the QBR narrative and runway ask: 

1) Status snapshot (short):
- Serving runtime OKR: on track for latency SLOs; one regression in large-batch tail we still have open (infra bug).
- Deploy & Rollouts OKR: canary infra is ~70% automated; manual rollback still required for multi-model routing.
- Cost optimization OKR: initial batching/kv cache proofs look promising — expected 8–12% unit gains.

2) Proposal to narrow QBR scope: spotlight on production economics (latency & unit cost) + customer success stories. Recommend pushing the deep model-quantization narrative to a follow-up tech session so exec time stays focused.

3) Dependency asks (critical):
- Two dedicated GPU slots (pilot-capacity) for a Brightware pilot the week of 10/26 — procurement is asking about start dates. Need confirmation whether we can allocate from Dedicated reserve or require burst capacity.
- One on-call engineer (ops) for the QBR demo window (11/2) — request volunteer or assign.

Attachments: QBR-spotlight-deck-v1.pdf (draft), runway-risk-grid.xlsx

I know this is tight — if you disagree with the narrow-scope ask, call it out. I'll stitch inputs into the deck.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
VP, Growth & Strategy
Redwood Inference

--

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks

Naomi —

Appreciate the concise framing. A few quick notes: 

- We can cover the large-batch tail regression in a single slide (impact + mitigation) — agree to push deep quantization to follow-up.
- GPU slots: short answer is yes for a limited pilot if we reduce slot size to 0.5 GPU equivalents via multiplexing (we've done similar with smaller models). I'll own a detailed plan by Monday.
- Ops for demo on 11/2: I'll assign Priya to be primary and we'll have an on-call backup from infra.

Action items for me: send multiplex plan (by Mon 10/18), short slide on regression impact.

-Markus
Engineering Director, Serving Runtime

--

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks

Naomi/Markus —

Support the narrowed narrative. Two asks from my side: 

- Need explicit language on risk & recovery timeline for the regression slide — execs will want to know "what could go wrong and how quickly can we fix it."
- If Brightware pilot is a win, it materially changes our Dedicated capacity narrative; procurement will expect a start date. I'd like the deck to include a conditional lane: "if pilot greenlit, demonstrate capacity plan and revenue upside".

I'll draft the risk language and the conditional lane; expect a draft by Tue end of day.

V
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Success

--

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@brightware.com>, Contracts <contracts@brightware.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks

Jamie / Contracts —

Forwarding a short exec-level ask from our internal planning: Brightware indicated interest in a small dedicated-pilot the week of 10/26. To confirm scheduling we need: 

- Target start date (earliest possible)
- Any procurement constraints on short-term pilot slots (we can offer burst capacity vs reserved GPU slots)
- NDA/PO requirements for pilot services

We can demo the integration during our pilot window and surface metrics in Redwood's QBR if timing aligns. Markus/Vanessa/Tessa are on the cc for technical/CS coordination.

Simple next steps: reply with earliest start date and the contact to handle the SOW/PO. Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Naomi

Attachment: QBR-spotlight-deck-v1.pdf

--

From: Jamie Park <jamie@brightware.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Contracts <contracts@brightware.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic spotlight: resource clarifications and QBR prep asks

Naomi / team —

Great to see the proposed scope. We can start the pilot as early as 10/26 but will need a one-page SOW and an internal PO by 10/22 to free up our infra booking. Contracts, could you confirm the PO steps?

On the technical side we prefer reserved-minimum capacity rather than burst for stability; Jamie (cc) from our infra team will coordinate with Markus to pin the exact SKU.

I'll loop our procurement contact now — Contracts@brightware.com — they will send the PO template.

Thanks,
Jamie Park
Head of Product
Brightware
